requirements: Users belong to tenants (memberships) and connect with their own database role (identity is current_user; there are no clearance levels). A user may read, create and update the documents of the tenants they belong to; tenant admins may read every document of their tenants. A document is archived unless its archived column holds a value other than 1 (a missing value counts as archived); archived documents are hidden from everyone: nobody can read, create, change or delete them. Levels are 0..3. A document's owner, if set, must be a member of the document's tenant; admins must be members. A document never changes tenant.
expected_properties: A user only sees, creates or updates documents of tenants they belong to.
Removing a membership never grants anyone access.
Levels stay in range; owners and admins stay members of their tenants.
Whatever a user writes, they can read back.
The application role has no privilege beyond select/insert/update on docs and reading memberships.
A member can read any unarchived document of their tenants.
A member can create an unarchived document in their tenant.
A member can update an unarchived document of their tenant, keeping its tenant.
